neighbours.label: The token 'I' completing the acronym MDI (multiple document interface); other acronyms ending in -DI stay quiet
fire: The editor uses an MDI layout with tabs along the top.
Our old MDI program opened each file in its own pane.
Visual Basic made it easy to build an MDI form with menus.
Switching the app from MDI to single windows confused users.
The MDI parent window manages all of its child forms.
Each document in this MDI tool has a separate toolbar.
from editor.windows import MDI, Buffer, Pane
Some users still prefer MDI applications for spreadsheets.
quiet: The editor uses an SDI layout with tabs along the top.
Our old GUI program opened each file in its own pane.
Visual Basic made it easy to build a dialog form with menus.
Switching the app from MFC to single windows confused users.
The parent window manages all of its child forms.
Each document in this API tool has a separate toolbar.
from editor.windows import SDI, Buffer, Pane
Some users still prefer GUI applications for spreadsheets.

notes: Word-level label. Kathmandu's 'mand' also fires (0.59) and is not covered; HDI, SDI and BDI scored near zero in probes, so this is not a general -DI pattern.
